Facts: Defendant Ni used a vulnerability in a third-party payment platform (Jinmi bag) to illegally withdraw money using fiddler to intercept packets. He stole 600 RMB first, then 7,300 RMB. Then he taught others (Lin, Yang, Guo, Zhang) the method, and they each stole a total of about 590,000 RMB, paying him a fee. So Ni is involved in theft (robbery? but using secret means, i.e., fraud? The description: "采用秘密手段，窃取公私财物" which is typical language for "盗窃罪" (theft). Also "向他人传授犯罪方法" is "组织、领导、帮助他人实施犯罪" maybe "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪"? But more likely "帮助他人实施盗窃罪" or "帮助他人犯罪" which is "帮助犯罪" under Chinese law. However there is a specific offense: "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (Article 286) for providing technical means to commit crimes using the internet. Using fiddler to intercept packets and teaching others is providing technical means. The charge could be "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪". But the prosecution says "向他人传授犯罪方法，应当以××追究其刑事责任". In Chinese law, that is "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (Article 286). Also "盗窃罪" for the theft itself.

Thus charges: 盗窃罪;帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪.

The act of using fiddler to intercept and withdraw is akin to "非法获取计算机信息系统数据" but the result is theft. Usually prosecutors may charge both "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" and "盗窃罪". However the summary says "采用秘密手段，窃取公私财物" which is theft. And "向他人传授犯罪方法" is "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪". So we will list those two.
